meta.title: A Card for Palm Lake
meta.textType: story: a class card and plans for the new year

paragraphs: On Wednesday, December twenty-third, Teacher Kim sat at her desk in the afternoon. A big green card lay on her desk. Gold and silver paper stars lay next to it. "Good afternoon, class," she said. "Ms. Ong has sent us a lovely email." Lily, Leo, and May stood around the desk and read it on the laptop. "Dear Teacher Kim and class, congratulations on one thousand visitors to your blog!" "Thank you for the invitation to read it." "What are you doing in January?" "Best wishes, Ms. Ong." "In January we are going on a trip, and the place is a surprise," said Teacher Kim.

Just then, Mia ran into the classroom. "I am sorry I am late," she said. "My kitten Snow hid my shoe." "Thank you for telling me," said Teacher Kim. "Please sit down, Mia." Everybody was pleased about the email, so the class wanted to celebrate. Teacher Kim put a bowl of mango and sticky rice on a desk for dessert. Then she held out her phone at arm's length. "Let's take a class selfie!" All the children squeezed into the picture and smiled. "Would you finish the card at home, Lily?" asked Teacher Kim.

That evening, Lily sat at the kitchen table at home. She stuck the gold and silver stars on the green card. Pip sat beside the table and lifted one paw. Lily smiled and put a little blue paint on his paw. Pip pressed it on the corner of the card. One blue paw print stayed there.

Then Lily wrote the words "THANK YOU, FRIENDS!" on the card. Under the title, she wrote a short message. "Dear Ms. Ong and class, thank you for your email." "We hope that you have a happy new year." "Tomorrow we are posting this card to you." Lily checked each word, because she wanted no mistakes.

Mom came into the kitchen. "Would you show me the card, please?" she asked. Mom looked at the paw print and smiled. "Tomorrow I am taking it to school," said Lily. "Teacher Kim is sending it to Palm Lake in the afternoon." Pip lay down under the table, and Lily felt happy.
text.summary: Teacher Kim reads an email from Ms. Ong to the class. Mia comes late with an excuse, the class celebrates, and Lily finishes the thank-you card at home with Pip.

sentences.text: On Wednesday, December twenty-third, Teacher Kim sat at her desk in the afternoon.
A big green card lay on her desk.
Gold and silver paper stars lay next to it.
"Good afternoon, class," she said.
"Ms. Ong has sent us a lovely email."
Lily, Leo, and May stood around the desk and read it on the laptop.
"Dear Teacher Kim and class, congratulations on one thousand visitors to your blog!"
"Thank you for the invitation to read it."
"What are you doing in January?"
"Best wishes, Ms. Ong."
"In January we are going on a trip, and the place is a surprise," said Teacher Kim.
Just then, Mia ran into the classroom.
"I am sorry I am late," she said.
"My kitten Snow hid my shoe."
"Thank you for telling me," said Teacher Kim.
"Please sit down, Mia."
Everybody was pleased about the email, so the class wanted to celebrate.
Teacher Kim put a bowl of mango and sticky rice on a desk for dessert.
Then she held out her phone at arm's length.
"Let's take a class selfie!"
All the children squeezed into the picture and smiled.
"Would you finish the card at home, Lily?" asked Teacher Kim.
That evening, Lily sat at the kitchen table at home.
She stuck the gold and silver stars on the green card.
Pip sat beside the table and lifted one paw.
Lily smiled and put a little blue paint on his paw.
Pip pressed it on the corner of the card.
One blue paw print stayed there.
Then Lily wrote the words "THANK YOU, FRIENDS!" on the card.
Under the title, she wrote a short message.
"Dear Ms. Ong and class, thank you for your email."
"We hope that you have a happy new year."
"Tomorrow we are posting this card to you."
Lily checked each word, because she wanted no mistakes.
Mom came into the kitchen.
"Would you show me the card, please?" she asked.
Mom looked at the paw print and smiled.
"Tomorrow I am taking it to school," said Lily.
"Teacher Kim is sending it to Palm Lake in the afternoon."
Pip lay down under the table, and Lily felt happy.
